text.retentionText: Beispieltext, vor dem Einsatz vom Studio anzupassen: Die Dokumentation wird während der Terminvorbereitung und Durchführung und anschließend nur so lange aufbewahrt, wie sie zum Nachweis der Einwilligung oder zur Geltendmachung, Ausübung oder Verteidigung von Rechtsansprüchen erforderlich ist. Maßgeblich sind die jeweils einschlägigen Verjährungsfristen und die Erforderlichkeit im Einzelfall. Bei Ansprüchen wegen Körper- oder Gesundheitsschäden kann die Verjährungshöchstfrist nach § 199 Abs. 2 BGB 30 Jahre betragen; daraus folgt keine pauschale Aufbewahrungspflicht von 30 Jahren. Entfallen die Zwecke und besteht keine weitere Rechtsgrundlage, löscht der Inhaber die Unterlagen einschließlich der Kopien im Speicher der App und der lokalen Sicherungskopien. Bei einem konkreten Rechtsstreit bleiben die hierfür erforderlichen Unterlagen bis zu dessen Abschluss und dem Wegfall weiterer Aufbewahrungsgründe erhalten.

app.headline: Tattoo Consent
app.description: Welcome to Musterstudio. Please fill in your details and discuss any open questions with your tattoo artist before your tattoo.
app.photoText: I voluntarily allow Musterstudio (Beispiel) to photograph my finished tattoo and to publish it to show the studio's own tattoo work in the studio portfolio, on www.musterstudio.example and on its own Instagram profile @musterstudio.example. No names, faces, health information, consent forms or signatures are published. The tattoo itself may still make me recognisable. A no has no effect on the tattoo. I can withdraw this consent at any time for the future, verbally with the owner or by email to datenschutz@musterstudio.example, including for individual publication channels listed above. Processing carried out before the withdrawal remains lawful. The studio will end the affected use and remove the photos from the publications it can influence, unless another legal basis applies. For publications on the internet and social media, platform operators and third parties may store, further distribute or process the images outside the EU; full retrieval of copies held by others cannot be guaranteed. A new agreement is required for other purposes of use or further platforms. This declaration does not transfer any rights to the tattoo motif.
app.photoDeniedText: The offered photo consent was declined. There is no consent to publish my tattoo photos for the portfolio, website or social media. A no has no effect on the treatment.
app.signatureText: With my signature I confirm my details and the declarations I have selected. I voluntarily consent to the described tattoo. My decision on photos remains independent of this.

studio.retention: Sample text, to be adapted by the studio before use: the documentation is kept during the preparation and performance of the appointment, and afterwards only for as long as it is needed to prove the consent or to assert, exercise or defend legal claims. The applicable limitation periods and the necessity in the individual case are decisive. For claims arising from personal injury or harm to health, the maximum limitation period under § 199(2) of the German Civil Code (BGB) can be 30 years; this does not mean a blanket 30-year retention duty. Once the purposes no longer apply and there is no other legal basis, the owner deletes the records, including the copies in the app's storage and the local backup copies. In the event of an actual legal dispute, the records needed for it are kept until it ends and no further grounds for retention remain.
studio.recipients: Sample text, to be adapted by the studio before use: only the owner, Max Mustermann, has access to the consent PDF and the health data it contains. Filing and backup take place locally; this app has no automatic cloud synchronisation or transmission. Any disclosure required by law remains reserved. The separately chosen publication of tattoo photos does not include passing on this form, the health data or the signature.

bloodMeds.title: Blood-thinning medication
bloodMeds.hint: Do you take, for example, aspirin, ASA or Marcumar?

allergies.title: Allergies or intolerances
allergies.hint: e.g. to plasters, latex, nickel, disinfectants or dyes

infections.title: Known infectious diseases
infections.hint: e.g. hepatitis or HIV; please only give relevant details

skin.title: Skin conditions at the tattoo site
skin.hint: e.g. eczema, psoriasis, dermatitis or open areas of skin

chronic.title: Heart, diabetes, epilepsy or circulation
chronic.hint: Do you have heart conditions, diabetes, epilepsy, or a tendency towards circulation problems?

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy or breastfeeding
pregnancy.hint: Are you currently pregnant or breastfeeding?

painkillers.title: Painkillers before the appointment
painkillers.hint: Have you taken any painkillers before the appointment?

clotting.title: Blood clotting or wound healing
clotting.hint: Do you have clotting disorders, poor wound healing, or a tendency to excessive scarring?

immune.title: Immune system, antibiotics or other therapy
immune.hint: Do you have a weakened immune system, or are you taking antibiotics, immunosuppressants or other relevant medication?

acute.title: Acute illness or fever
acute.hint: Are you currently ill, feverish, or do you have an acute infection?

alcohol24.title: Alcohol in the last 24 hours
alcohol24.hint: Have you consumed alcohol in the last 24 hours?

adult.title: I am at least 18 years old.
adult.text: This applies today and on the stated tattoo appointment date.

voluntary.title: I am choosing this tattoo voluntarily.
voluntary.text: I consent to the introduction of colour pigments using needles and the resulting injury to my skin at the described body site.

consultation.title: My questions were answered in a personal conversation.
consultation.text: I was given clear information, had enough time for questions, and have given truthful answers to the relevant health questions. I will report any changes before the procedure begins.

risks.title: I have been informed about the risks.
risks.text: These include pain, bleeding, swelling, redness, inflammation, infections, allergic reactions and scarring. Reactions can also occur with a delay; long-term health effects are not conclusively established.

permanent.title: I understand that my tattoo is permanent.
permanent.text: Complete, scar-free removal cannot be guaranteed. Colours and outlines can change due to skin, healing, ageing and sun exposure.

design.title: Motif, size and placement have been agreed with me.
design.text: I have checked the discussed design or stencil and agree to it being carried out. Any further changes will be discussed with me before the procedure begins.

aftercare.title: I have received and understood the written aftercare instructions.
aftercare.text: I will follow the individual aftercare instructions and seek medical advice, as well as inform the studio, if there are signs of infection, allergy or other complications.

liability.title: Aftercare and statutory rights
liability.text: I will follow the aftercare instructions I received and seek medical advice, as well as inform the studio, if problems arise. My statutory rights arising from a defective service or breach of duty by the studio remain unaffected. This declaration is not a waiver of liability.

privacy.title: I expressly consent to the processing of my health information.
privacy.text: I expressly consent to Musterstudio (Beispiel), owner Max Mustermann, processing the health information I have given on this form for the personal preliminary conversation, preparing the agreed tattoo and documenting that I was informed and gave consent, and storing it in the local consent PDF. I received the privacy notice on access, retention and my rights before this decision. I can withdraw this consent at any time for the future, verbally with the owner or by email to datenschutz@musterstudio.example. Processing carried out before the withdrawal remains lawful. Further retention for legal defence is only possible under the conditions stated in the privacy notice. My decision on the use of photos is independent of this.
